map.角焊缝有效厚度为什么取 0.7hf？: Why is the fillet weld effective thickness taken as 0.7hf?
The load-bearing section of a fillet weld is the minimum section along the 45° direction, whose thickness is about 0.7 times the leg size hf (he=0.7hf). This is a simplified assumption in GB 50017; actual penetration is slightly greater, but designing at 0.7hf is on the safe side.
